---
name: dave-interests-cars-and-park
description: Dave's interests: classic cars and auto engineering, photography (new hobby Oct 2023, vintage camera Nov 2023, nature/sunsets/beaches/waterfalls), calming park visits and regular walks with friends, mountain trip booked for July 2023, live music (Aerosmith fan, Boston rock concert Sept 2023, music festival with The Fireworks headlining Oct 2023), plays guitar in a rock band (June 2023, logo shared Nov 2023), vinyl and classic rock, card nights with friends, chats with neighbors about current events, lives in Boston, wants to visit Japan
type: user
---
Dave loves cars: as of 23 March 2023 he attended a classic car show and enjoyed talking with owners about their stories. He went to another car show around 13-16 April 2023 (the weekend before 20 April); he loves classic cars and the dedication in restoring them, and says that's why he's into auto engineering. He has also been spending lots of time at a beautiful, calming park.

Dave loves music: around 18-19 March 2023 he went to a music festival in Boston and finally saw Aerosmith live, his favorite act of the festival. He did not meet them.

Dave knows the Boston music scene well (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park) and offers to show friends around town.

Update 9 June 2023: Dave explores Boston parks on weekends to relax and recharge (strolled on Friday 2 June). Likes hiking/nature though hasn't hiked recently. He booked a trip to a mountainous region for July 2023 and plans to take lots of photos to show Calvin.

Update 21 June 2023: Dave recently joined a rock band and is practicing guitar; he shared a photo of the band members with Calvin.

Update 7 July 2023: Dave arranged regular park walks with friends; they have a favorite riverside spot (sunset views). He has never been to Japan but is keen to go someday (interested in its music, food, tech and culture).

Update 22 Aug 2023: Dave had a card night with friends on Friday 18 Aug 2023 and enjoyed it a lot.

Update 15 Sept 2023: Dave's band had a great jam/rehearsal on 14 Sept 2023 (not recorded). He attended a rock concert in Boston around 9-10 Sept 2023. He likes Ratatouille-style 'follow your dreams' messages (a favorite Disney movie theme).

Update 15 Oct 2023: Dave just got back from an amazing music festival headlined by The Fireworks; he shared a photo of the main stage with Calvin.

Update 23 Oct 2023: Dave recently chatted with neighbors about current events and politics and enjoys hearing different perspectives. He shared photos from concerts he attended in Sept 2023.

Update 29 Oct 2023: Dave has recently gotten into photography as a creative outlet for capturing the beauty of nature; he shared Boston sunset photos and a clock tower shot at sunset with Calvin.

Update 2 Nov 2023: Dave shared his rock band's logo with Calvin. He writes lyrics and notes in a notebook for motivation, listens to vinyl while doing car work, and lately is into classic rock.

Update 17 Nov 2023: Dave bought a vintage camera in Nov 2023 for photography. He loves shooting nature (sunsets, beaches, waves); shared a rocks-and-waterfall photo from a nearby park and found a bench under a tree with pink flowers he wants to take Calvin to.
files.calvin-japan-trip.md:
---
name: calvin-japan-trip
description: Calvin (Dave's friend, musician): Tokyo trip/performance, Frank Ocean tour and collaboration deal (Aug 2023), tour ended, Miami video shoot, album released 11 Sept 2023, album party at Japanese house (~26 Oct 2023), next tour planned, met Boston artists to collaborate (3 Oct 2023), octopus guitar, home flooded (May 2023), car accident (June 2023, repaired), Ferrari (new one ~early Oct 2023), worldwide brand goal, rap podcast, loves "California Love", wants jam with Dave (Sept 2023), touring with Frank Ocean and going to Tokyo Nov 2023 (19 Oct 2023), networking event and new album nearly finished (29 Oct 2023), studio and TV room, mentoring young musicians and high school friend at Boston show (Nov 2023), Boston gala 16 Nov 2023 and upcoming Boston show
type: project
---
Calvin is a musician and Dave's friend. Known events: Tokyo festival/performance, Frank Ocean tour, home flooded (May 2023), car accident (June 2023, repaired), album in progress, Boston visit July 2023 (Dave hosting), new mansion and luxury car.

Update 3 Aug 2023: Calvin owns a Ferrari, is attached to it and just took it for a service (stressful). He sees it as a reminder of his hard work and motivation. His current goal is to expand his brand worldwide, grow his fanbase, and collaborate with artists around the globe. He performed with his band the night of 2 Aug 2023.

Update 14 Aug 2023: Calvin said the tour with a well-known artist ended with a Tokyo show where the crowd sang along to his song (he shared a photo); he then explored his new place in Japan.

Update 22 Aug 2023: Calvin scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean, whom he met at a Tokyo music festival; they recorded a song in the studio at Calvin's mansion. Someone also noticed his festival performance and now works with him. His tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, hoping to meet Dave (Dave asked for details). On 21 Aug 2023 Calvin recorded a podcast with friends about the evolving rap industry; he'll share when it's uploaded.

Update 31 Aug 2023: Calvin's tour has ended; he called performing on the big stage a dream come true. Around 26 Aug 2023 he started shooting a video for his new album, filming in Miami on a beach. Dave offered help with props and Calvin said he'd ask if needed. Calvin has a custom purple, shiny-finish guitar with an octopus design, made by a Japanese artist friend; it represents his love of art and the sea and his friendships. He values staying true to himself and being unique in his music.

Update 2 Sept 2023: Calvin booked a flight to Boston around late Aug 2023 and will contact Dave when he arrives; Dave will catch up with him there.

Update 13 Sept 2023: Calvin's album dropped on 11 Sept 2023 and has been well received; he finds it overwhelming but motivating. Next he has another tour (cities not shared), then plans to explore and grow his brand. He'll take Dave up on the offer to see Dave's garage and will let Dave know when he's in Boston.

Update 22 Sept 2023: Calvin shared a photo symbolizing his hard work, recalled a memorable summer drive, and said his Japan trip was incredible and he longs to go back. His favorite childhood song is "California Love" (Tupac and Dr. Dre), from road trips with his dad. He and Dave agreed to have a jam session together soon.

Update 4 Oct 2023: On 3 Oct 2023 Calvin met several artists in Boston (introduced by a mutual friend) and discussed collaborating on new music; he's excited about their individual styles. He also shares a car project he works on to relax.

Update 15 Oct 2023: Calvin said he got a new Ferrari the previous week (~8 Oct 2023) and promised Dave a photo. His motivation approach for setbacks: remember his passion, lean on helpful people, take breaks for favorite activities.

Update 19 Oct 2023: Calvin says he is touring with Frank Ocean (met at a festival in Aug 2022 per Calvin; Frank wanted to collaborate); crowd energy great, shared Tokyo concert photos. Dave said he'll attend one of the shows. Calvin plans to go to Tokyo in Nov 2023 after the tour ends (Shibuya Crossing, Shinjuku, food); he hasn't tried ramen and will try it there. Dave has never been to Tokyo but dreams of going; he shared a Boston ramen photo.

Update 29 Oct 2023: Calvin attended a networking event with other artists; the contacts will help build his fan base. He's had great recent collaborations, his album is almost finished, and he'll send Dave previews. He'll let Dave know when he's free to catch up.

Update 2 Nov 2023: Calvin threw a small album-release party at his Japanese house/mansion about 26 Oct 2023, with family and friends. He has a separate music studio (work only) and a cozy TV room where he watches music videos, concerts and artist documentaries for inspiration.

Update 13 Nov 2023: Calvin invited an old high school friend (they freestyled together as teens) to see him perform in Boston; the friend has long been supportive. Calvin stresses supportive relationships are key for artists. He's mentoring young musicians from a music program, plans to support them long-term, and is making beats for one young artist; he's experimenting with new sounds in his studio.

Update 17 Nov 2023: Calvin attended a fancy gala in Boston on 16 Nov 2023 and had an inspiring chat with an artist about music and art. He accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston (details to come); he'll catch up with Dave when in Boston. He also shot a photo in a Japanese garden.

files.dave-car-shop.md:
---
name: dave-car-shop
description: Dave opened his own car maintenance shop (reported 1 May 2023, celebrated with friends), teaming up with a local garage (3 May 2023); fixes cars as therapy (restored cars with his dad as a kid; started at age ten with a neighbor's old car); selected for car mod workshop (11 Aug 2023), attended car workshop in San Francisco (back 1 Sept 2023); finished restoring a vintage car (15 Sept 2023); vintage Mustang engine trouble (22 Sept 2023), Mustang from junkyard restored (photo 4 Oct 2023); car show 6 Oct 2023 and own restored/modified car with custom exhaust; lost a long-pursued deal to a competing shop (Oct 2023); dreams of building a custom car from scratch; invited Calvin to see his garage (Sept 2023); attended Detroit conference (Oct 2023); finished latest car restoration project (29 Oct 2023); started a car mod blog (by 2 Nov 2023)
type: user
---
As of 1 May 2023, Dave has opened his own car maintenance shop, a long-held dream. He works on all kinds of cars, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It is a step toward his bigger dream of working on classic cars, which he is obsessed with (design and engineering). He restored a classic car in 2022 and is proud of it. He invited Calvin to visit the shop.

Update 3 May 2023: Dave is teaming up with a local garage. He loves the job, working with mechanics and sharing his car knowledge, and is currently on a challenging car project. He plans to keep learning auto engineering and dreams of someday building a custom car from scratch. He assists customers.

Update 16 May 2023: Dave told Calvin he held an opening celebration with friends and it has been going amazingly.

Update 31 May 2023: Dave fixed a neighbor's car engine himself and happily helps neighbors. He finds fixing things therapeutic and gives him a sense of achievement and purpose (giving things a second chance).

Update 3 Aug 2023: Dave said fixing cars is like therapy and refurbishing gives fulfillment. Origin: he grew up working on cars with his dad, and one summer they restored an old car together (he shared a photo with Calvin).

Update 11 Aug 2023: Dave was picked for a car mod workshop, a dream come true toward learning auto engineering and building a custom car. He has done engine swaps and suspension mods and is now learning body modifications, giving a classic muscle car a modern twist (silver finish). He also has a music studio setup with a high-quality sound system and offered to help Calvin with music (Calvin declined, busy).

Update 14 Aug 2023: Dave attended a car restoration workshop in San Francisco, found people passionate and inspiring, and saw many techniques. He was restoring a car (went from beat-up to beautiful) and hoped to finish by end of September 2023.

Update 2 Sept 2023: Dave returned from San Francisco on 1 Sept 2023 with insights on car modification and wants to share them with Calvin. He feels fixing cars gives him purpose and pride, making a difference for customers.

Update 13 Sept 2023: Dave again invited Calvin to see his garage and shared a photo of it; Calvin accepted and will visit when in Boston.

Update 15 Sept 2023: Dave finished the vintage car restoration and shared the final photo with Calvin. He finds it very satisfying, especially people's reactions to the finished car, and plans to keep making people happy through his work.

Update 22 Sept 2023: Dave hit a setback on his vintage Mustang: he worked on the engine, thought it was fixed, but it made a weird noise on startup. He was disappointed and shared a photo of the engine with Calvin.

Update 4 Oct 2023: Dave said he restored a Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (in bad shape but with potential) and shared a photo of the result with Calvin. He finds transforming old, beat-up cars satisfying; small successes make him proud and fulfilled.

Update 8 Oct 2023: Dave went to a car show on Friday 6 Oct 2023 and got to try car mods. He shared a photo of a car he restored and modified himself, with a custom exhaust and performance upgrades. He spent hours as a kid tinkering with engines in his dad's garage (his sanctuary); working on cars is his lifelong goal and now his job. Calvin is looking forward to seeing his garage.

Update 15 Oct 2023: A competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal Dave's shop had pursued for months; he felt bummed and questioned whether his effort was wasted, but resolved to keep pushing with faith and patience. Motivated by the joy of making broken things whole.

Update 23 Oct 2023: Dave shared a photo of his garage (a little dirty but organized) and calls working on cars his calm oasis for connecting with himself. His passion began at age ten, when he asked a neighbor if he could fix an old car in their garage. He restored a car last year and sold it to a collector; he's now on a new, challenging restoration project and says patience and attention to detail are key.

Update 25 Oct 2023: Dave recently attended a conference in Detroit and learned a lot. He shared a photo of his latest car project (working on cars calms him). He told Calvin his dad took him to his first car show at age 10, and he describes himself as an automotive engineer. Calvin also loves cars.

Update 29 Oct 2023: Dave said he just finished restoring his latest car project and invited Calvin to come see it.

Update 2 Nov 2023: Dave recently started a blog on car mods to share his passion; people read it and ask him for advice, and a post on a car mod inspired readers to start DIY projects. He recently found a car in bad shape (~late Oct 2023), restored it, and spent a lot of effort cleaning, polishing and protecting its headlights. He listens to vinyl (old player) while working on cars and lately enjoys classic rock.
